precepts.text: I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel; Ezekiel was made the sign, and in verse 11 he tells Israel, I am your sign.
precepts.point: Take counsel together and it shall come to nought, for God is with us, Immanuel: once the child was born, the two kings could not succeed against Judah.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

precepts.why:
The Lord told Ezekiel to bear his stuff on his shoulders in their sight and carry it forth in the twilight, covering his face “that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.” God made Ezekiel himself a sign unto the house of Israel.

Read on to verse 11 and Ezekiel is told to say it to Israel plainly: “Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.” What the prophet did, Israel would go through.

This lines up with Isaiah 8. When the Lord gives a sign, it is the man and the child he gives, not the woman. Isaiah and his children were signs and wonders in Israel, and Ezekiel was set for a sign to the house of Israel, which is why the sign of Isaiah 7:14 is the child born to Isaiah and the prophetess.

precepts.text: We dwell in the midst of a rebellious house, having eyes to see and see not, ears to hear and hear not; this is why we cannot understand the Lord's voice in the thunder.
precepts.point: The Most High sent out arrows and lightning and scattered his enemies, and the channels of the sea and the foundations of the world were discovered at the rebuking of the Lord, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils. His power over creation is total.

note.label: 2 Samuel 22: The Lord Is My Rock and My Fortress

precepts.why:
“Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they are a rebellious house.”

That is why we cannot understand the Lord’s voice in the thunder. The Lord thunders from heaven and the Most High utters his voice, but we dwell in the midst of a rebellious house, with ears to hear that hear not. We no longer have that spirit upon us, so his voice sounds like clouds clashing, the way Esau tells it.

points: The word of the Lord came saying that Ezekiel dwells in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see and see not, and ears to hear and hear not.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: Ezekiel is told to prepare stuff for removing and to remove by day in their sight from one place to another, that it may be they will consider, though they be a rebellious house.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: He is to bring forth his stuff by day as stuff for captivity and go forth in the evening in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: He is to dig down through the wall in their sight while they watch, carry his stuff out through it upon his shoulders in the twilight, and cover his face that he see not the ground, meaning disguise his face, for the Most High set him for a sign unto the house of Israel.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: Ezekiel did as commanded, bringing forth his stuff by day, digging through the wall by hand in the evening, and bearing it upon his shoulder in their sight.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: In the morning the word of the Lord asked whether the rebellious house had not asked Ezekiel what he was doing.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: He is to tell them this burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem, King Zedekiah, and all the house of Israel among them; as Ezekiel had done, so shall it be done unto them.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: Just as Ezekiel's example showed, the southern kingdom with King Zedekiah shall remove and go into captivity.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: The prince shall bear his stuff upon his shoulder in the twilight and go forth, digging through the wall to carry out, and cover his face that he see not the ground, for when you read the history he tried to escape and disguise himself.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: The Most High will spread His net upon him and take him in His snare, bringing him to Babylon in the land of the Chaldeans, yet he shall not see it though he shall die there.
There is no place to run and no place to hide; the net is for all the children going into the Babylonian captivity, but that prince will die in Babylon.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: He will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and draw out the sword after them, that they may know He is the Lord.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: He will leave a few men from the sword, famine, and pestilence, a remnant alive, that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen where they come.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: The word of the Lord told Ezekiel to eat his bread with quaking and drink his water with trembling and carefulness.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: He is to say to the people of Jerusalem and the land of Israel that they shall eat their bread with carefulness and drink their water with astonishment, and the land shall be desolate because of the violence of them that dwell therein.

At one time we did not have to tremble over what we ate and drank, but because the wicked counsel gave the people a false sense of security, the Most High promised our people would tremble and shake over their food and drink, a reality check.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: The Lord asked about the proverb in the land of Israel, that the days are prolonged and every vision fails.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: The Most High will make that proverb cease so they use it no more in Israel, for He will make the prophecies come to pass quickly; the days are at hand and the effect of every vision.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: The people heard the prophecy but said it would not come to pass in their time, that it was beyond them and nothing to worry about.
He will speak, and the word He speaks shall come to pass and be no more prolonged.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: The house of Israel was saying the vision Ezekiel saw is for many days to come, that it would happen when they were gone and dead, prophesying of times far off.

note.label: Ezekiel 12: Prepare Thy Stuff for Removing

points: The Most High declares that none of His words shall be prolonged any more, but the word which He has spoken shall be done, fulfilled quickly.
